_comment: Single source of truth for the fast-moving DDEV facts this skill states. scripts/audit-ddev-config.py READS it (defaults, EOL floors, obsolete keys, the config schema's keys, built-in command names); scripts/check-ddev-facts.py VERIFIES it (--offline: prose still states each token and each token still contains its value; --live: GitHub releases, the docs config page and the config schema at the release tag, the built-in command listing, endoflife.date). Sources on as_of: https://api.github.com/repos/ddev/ddev/releases, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddev/ddev/<tag>/docs/content/users/configuration/config.md, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddev/ddev/<tag>/pkg/ddevapp/schema.json (config_keys, read 2026-10-14), pkg/ddevapp/global_dotddev_assets/commands/<service> at the tag, https://endoflife.date/api/{php,nodejs}.json. Bump a value, its prose, and the 'Versions verified' note in SKILL.md in one commit.

eol_floor._comment: Oldest release line still supported upstream on as_of (endoflife.date eol date in the future). Anything older is end of life.

obsolete_keys._comment: DDEV loads config.yaml non-strictly (via Viper since v1.25.2, no unused-key error), so a key it no longer defines is silently ignored rather than rejected.
obsolete_keys.nfs_mount_enabled: NFS support was removed in v1.25.0; the key is ignored. Use performance_mode.
obsolete_keys.mutagen_enabled: Replaced by performance_mode; the key is ignored, so Mutagen follows the global default.
obsolete_keys.upload_dir: Deprecated single-value form; DDEV migrates it, but write upload_dirs (a list).

_config_keys_comment: config_keys = the top-level properties of DDEV's own config schema, pkg/ddevapp/schema.json at release.tag (additionalProperties false). The auditor's unknown-key check reports any other top-level key; --live re-reads the schema and fails when the set moves. An obsolete_keys entry must NOT appear here.

builtin_commands._comment: Files DDEV ships in pkg/ddevapp/global_dotddev_assets/commands/<service> at release.tag (README and *.example excluded). A project .ddev/commands/<service>/<name> with the same name wins, because project commands are registered first.
